newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Perceptron cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perceptron cut to buy.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Monday it cut its rating of Perceptron Inc to buy from focus buy, mostly because of a lack of short-term earnings visibility.

-- Perceptron today said it expects revenue and earnings in the first quarter to be below analysts' expectations since some shipments expected in the period will actually be delivered in the second quarter. The company also said it was comfortable with estimates of 1997 earnings of $1.60 a share, Mesirow said.

-- Mesirow said it remains comfortable with Perceptron's management and overall prospects, especially in light of new order bookings in the first quarter and a substantial increase in order backlog to $26 million from a record $21 million at December 31.
-- Expectations of trading patterns rather than dissatisfaction with management or business trends prompted the downgrade, Mesirow said.
-- Mesirow's earnings estimate for 1997 is $1.55 a share.
-- Perceptron designs and makes three-dimensional machine vision systems.
